basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Senior Health Economist, Project Scientist III Posts
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) has invited applications by email for 3 vacancies, including Senior Health Economist (Medical/Non-Medical) and Project Scientist-III (Medical/Non-Medical) posts. Applications can be sent from 12 October 2026 to 24 October 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill out the application form provided with the notification.
Prepare a two-page CV and attach a recent photograph.
Compile the filled application form, CV, and supporting documents scanned into one PDF file.
Name the PDF file as "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (e.g., "James_DEO_2023_application").
Mention the name of the post applied for in the email subject line.
Email the complete application to [email protected] by 24.10.2026 up to 1.00 PM.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER)
One Year (With a possibility of extension up to 2 years based on performance)
Senior Health Economist (Medical/Non-Medical) and Project Scientist-III (Medical/Non-Medical)
Rs. 1,23,000/- per month + HRA (Senior Health Economist); Rs. 78,000/- per month + HRA (Project Scientist-III)

rows.essential_qualification: For Medical: Post Graduate Degree (MD/ MS/ DNB/ MPH) after MBBS with 3 years of research experience in the relevant field, plus knowledge of Computer Applications/Data Management. For Non-medical: Doctorate (Ph.D.) in the relevant subject (Community Medicine/ Preventive & Social Medicine/ Pediatrics/ Medicine/ Tropical Medicine/ Community Health Administration/ Health Administration/ Family Medicine/ Epidemiology/ Public Health) from a recognized university with 3 years of research experience in the relevant field.

For Medical: Essential: MBBS/BVSc/BDS with 3 years' experience or Post Graduate Degree in medical subjects after MBBS in the relevant subject; Or MPH/Ph.D in the relevant subject from a recognized University with 3 years' experience in the relevant field. For Non-medical: Essential: Ph.D degree in Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ Biotechnology subject from a recognized University with 2 years R&D/Teaching experience in the relevant subject after Ph.D.; Or MPH/ Pharm D (Doctor of Pharmacy)/Master's degree in the relevant subjects (Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ Biotechnology/Life sciences/ Pharmacy)/MHA from a recognized university with 5 years R&D/teaching experience in the relevant subject after Master's Degree.
rows.desirable: Additional post-doctoral research/teaching experience in health economics/health technology assessment in recognized institute(s); Knowledge of Computer Applications/Data Management.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely on a temporary basis for the DHR project titled "Health Technology Assessment-Centre of Excellence" in the Department of Preventive and Social Medicine, JIPMER. The likely duration is one year with a possibility of extension up to two years based on performance. The consolidated remuneration for Senior Health Economist is Rs. 1,23,000/- per month plus HRA, and for Project Scientist-III is Rs. 78,000/- per month plus HRA. Hiring of manpower may vary according to the study undertaken, but within the aforesaid budget, and in exceptional cases, a 10% variation will be permitted after approval of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill out the application form provided with the notification. Prepare a two-page CV and attach a recent photograph. Compile the filled application form, CV, and supporting documents scanned into one PDF file. Name the PDF file as "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (e.g., "James_DEO_2023_application"). Mention the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Email the complete application to [email protected] by 24.10.2026 up to 1.00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV, and documentary proof provided. The selection process includes an interview covering Health Technology Assessment, Research Methodology, and Basic Epidemiology. The final selection will be based on a CV, application, and interview. Interviews may be conducted in person or via videoconferencing at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. The interview is tentatively scheduled for the first week of November 2026, with exact dates notified to shortlisted applicants through email.

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: These positions are purely on a temporary and contract basis for an externally sponsored project and carry no claim to any regular post in JIPMER at any time.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the consolidated remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to the consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 1,23,000/- for Senior Health Economist and Rs. 78,000/- for Project Scientist-III. No other allowances or facilities are provided.

faq.question: Q3. What must be included in the email subject line when applying?
faq.answer: Candidates must mention the name of the post applied for in the email subject line.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted based on the details furnished in their application, CV, and the documentary proof provided.

faq.question: Q5. Can a candidate apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates wishing to apply for two or more different posts must fill out a separate application form for each post and send them with necessary enclosures in separate emails.
